title: intent init's report of what it wrote omits intent/.config/config.json
body:
`intent init`'s report of what it wrote omits `intent/.config/config.json` while listing every other file it created. Found by vc during the 2026-09-19 doc sweep; cc filed it.

`written` is filled only by the starter-content loop (`init.rs:367-371`). The config is written by a separate path, so it never enters the list the report prints. The only absence the code explains is `.prettierignore`'s, and that explanation (`init.rs:274`) belongs to the occupied-destination check, not to the report. The report of a fresh project therefore leaves out the one file that makes the directory a project.

Fix: report the config as written (or, if its absence is deliberate, say why next to the report). XS.
